description: This Java class 'TestSearchUpdaterStream' provides utility methods for unit testing parts of the updater stream in the 'thingsearch' persistence layer. It includes methods to create test streams, write 'Thing' objects (with optional ACLs), and delete 'Thing' objects by their identifiers and metadata. The class interacts with MongoDB via reactive streams and uses Akka Streams for processing.

classes.name: TestSearchUpdaterStream
classes.description: Utility class for unit testing the updater stream component in the 'thingsearch' persistence module. Provides methods to create test streams, write things with optional ACLs, and delete things based on identifiers and metadata.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of 'TestSearchUpdaterStream' using a provided MongoDatabase.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Encodes a 'Thing' object into JSON, converts it into a write model, and produces a reactive source for writing to the updater stream.

methods.name: writeThingWithAcl
methods.description: Prepares an 'Enforcer' for the given 'Thing' containing an ACL and writes it into the updater stream.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Creates a delete write model for a 'Thing' identified by its ID, revision, and policy information, and produces a reactive source to execute the deletion.

methods.name: delete (private)
methods.description: Internal method to produce a delete operation source from given metadata.
